name: Hip 1433
sale: Keeneland September Yearling Sale 2026, Book 3 — consigned by Terrazas Thoroughbreds, Agent IV
notes: Girvin (Tale of Ekati) died suddenly Aug 8, 2026 at Airdrie Stud, age 12 — one more crop still to come (2027 foals from his final book), then that's it, which supports demand on existing stock. Already a proven sire: 2 individual G1 winners (Dorth Vader, Faiza — the latter sold for $4M as a broodmare prospect), $18.8M progeny earnings from 5 crops. Fee had climbed from $7,500 to $30,000; a Girvin colt brought $725,000 on this sale's opening day. Dam Honor the Moment is unraced, first foal (blank slate), but 2nd dam Catch the Moment produced Grade 1 winner Smooth Roller (Awesome Again S.), and the female family traces to a half-sister of Secreto, the 1985 Epsom Derby winner, with recurring black type across 4 generations. $100,000 sits well below Girvin's recent yearling average ($139-157K) even as a Book 3 filly — reads as real value given the post-death demand bump.
